description: Work out which plates to put on each side of a barbell to reach a target weight, using standard gym plates or the plates you list. Reports the exact load and anything your plates can’t make.

bar.description: Bar weight in the chosen unit. Defaults to 20 kg or 45 lb.

collarWeight.description: Weight of each collar. Defaults to 2.5 kg or 5 lb.

collars.description: Count a collar on each side.

plates.description: Plates available, heaviest first or in any order: "25,20,15,10,5,2.5,1.25" for as many as needed, or "25:4,20:2" for pairs owned. Defaults to standard gym plates (kg: 25 to 1.25; lb: 45 to 2.5).

target.description: Total weight wanted on the bar, including the bar.

unit.description: Weight unit for every load in and out: kg or lb.

name: plate_loading
title: Barbell plate calculator
